summary: the doom suite, whose rows run the game without its WAD and wait for its second report of frames, with three faults in the game's sources

argv: test -f ports/doom/doom1.wad || { echo "doom-proof: ports/doom/doom1.wad is absent; the suite needs the WAD" >&2; exit 1; }; sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make ports/doom && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} ports/doom/doom

faults.name: status
faults.summary: the platform's exit reports 0 whatever status it is given

lines: without its WAD the game exited with status 0 and

faults.name: crash
faults.summary: the engine's refusal of a missing IWAD taken out, so that the engine goes on with no IWAD and faults reading its absent name

faults.name: stall
faults.summary: the platform draws no frame after its first, so that the game runs on without progress and never prints its second report

lines: the game printed 1 report(s) of its frames, the last counting 1 frames
